how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Every successful primary mint after mint number one produces one $5 commission. Mint number one produces no commission because no prior NFT exists. A valid referral sends the commission to the referrer, while a mint without a referral code sends it to a random existing NFT holder; secondary-market sales do not produce commissions.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Every successful primary mint after mint number one produces one Small Block prize ticket for the current draw. Mint number one produces no ticket because no prior NFT exists. A valid referral sends the ticket to the referrer, while a mint without a referral code sends it to a random existing NFT holder; secondary-market sales do not produce tickets, and more tickets provide more chances to win.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: Small Block awards 5 × $500 every 500 sales and Big Block awards 5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales, counting mint and secondary sales, with winners selected through Chainlink VRF.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically on-chain, while prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click.

decisions.reason: The first-primary-mint referral exception does not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, marketplace controls, or the rule that secondary sales generate no referral tickets.
